name: lgtm-links
description: lgtm for Codex: what you send a conversation from lgtm (your review, a comment to address) reaches it by itself, and /lgtm opens a pull request in lgtm.

interface.shortDescription: Your lgtm reviews reach Codex by themselves
interface.longDescription: lgtm is a GitHub and GitLab code review app for your Mac. With this plugin, a review or a comment you send a Codex conversation from lgtm is handed to it on your next message, without saying "check lgtm"; /lgtm opens a pull request in lgtm, linked to the conversation.
